product_one_liner.value: Nanonets provides AI agents and workflow automation that read and act on unstructured business data to automate processes such as accounts payable, claims, and order management for enterprise teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes the product as automating manual business processes using AI agents and names these business workflows.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page lists a Starter plan and usage rates, alongside Growth and Enterprise pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both are named in Nanonets customer stories on its customers page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 327 employees; this maps to the requested 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies San Francisco, California as headquarters; the company about page lists its San Francisco address.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile states it was founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows general research, product and industry content; it does not establish at least two engineering-authored posts on how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Nanonets has a public documentation site with an index and multiple product, architecture, and model documentation pages.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page links to a job board, but the accessible current board did not expose any live posting titles qualifying as AI, ML, or data-science roles.

model_provider.value: Nanonets' own model families: Spark, Flux, and Nova.
model_provider.notes: The public model-family documentation names these underlying product models; it does not identify an external model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The security policy says Nanonets is SOC 2 compliant and ISO/IEC 27001 certified.

last_funding.notes: Nanonets announced a $29 million Series B on March 12, 2024.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified round was announced in March 2024, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board linked from Careers did not expose any live posting with an SDR, BDR, sales-development representative, or account-executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index's newest dated items are from July 2026 and are research or explanatory posts, not product or major-feature launch announcements; no qualifying launch is shown in the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Sarthak Jain's profile reports his Nanonets CEO role ending in July 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both platforms are explicitly listed on Nanonets' integrations page under CRM, ticketing, and collaboration.
